One can ask the subtle Guru (Sukshma Guru) or the practical Guru (Karya Guru) using word, deed, and intellect. The Guru can change the karmic capacity only by making the disciple perform karma repeatedly. Vision (Darshan) is beyond thought and beyond intellect. It should not be doubted.

In this world, whether it is great beings or other living creatures, no two are alike. That is the glory of God. Experience (realization) is a glory. Acting from a place of experience should be done carefully. Acting from a place without experience will not cause disasters. There is no question of baseness being stirred up there. But where there is experience, the baseness within us will be stirred up without our knowledge. If one has experience, one will clash with the Guru. If one has no experience, one will simply get confused. There are so many examples of this here. Given this, it might seem better not to act at all. Bringing about devotion and publicizing it, even if done in a frenzy, should not be seen as a fault. It should come about like that. This birth is the remainder of taking bodies numerous times. Not everyone might get this fortune. Even the things experienced by the greatest sages are obtained by the children here. If devotion is maintained with discipline for three months, then it is enough to constantly carry it in the mind. It is enough for children to pray for a little time. Otherwise, the inclination (vasana) will be lost. One cannot consume too much of a good thing, can they? Can one eat ghee like one eats tapioca?

Some people only see the external garb. How should love be carried forward? There is a secret in spirituality that we do not know. To grasp it, one must suffer pain. Foresight encompasses thousands of spiritual visions and spiritual paths. Bhakti Darshana, Yoga Darshana, Karma Darshana, Dharma Darshana—the misfortune of this path is that even through a god or goddess, or even by a propounder of Yuga Dharma, these cannot be identified or described. Now, we need to highlight the great souls. Since we do not know what the Karma Darshana according to Yuga Dharma is, it remains distant even to those called seers. It is like asking what happened during the time of Rama or Ravana. There is no point in softly stating that the multitude of humans, who lack the knowledge to even correct and describe the worldview of the many ages that passed before, will not understand anything. However, there is an easy way. We need to cite the great ones as examples to understand, overcome, and clear the grand step of Yuga Dharma, wherein we cannot comprehend how long Karma and Dharma have been flowing astray. This is done by examining the course of Karma from Swayambhuva Manu to Vaivasvata Manu, who obtained foresight across Manvantaras and Kalpas, and by analyzing what a god, sage, ascetic, wise person, and devotee truly are. Let us take the shortest period. Time, as we describe it, consists of Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga, and Kali Yuga. A Chatur Yuga is formed by these four periods, transformed into an act of Karma by wise ones or practitioners—how many thousands of years does a wise person's foresight span! The length of a Yuga is made up of how many such wise ones. Who corrects and writes the Dharma of that Yuga? Then, how immensely profound will be the pain one has to experience when entering the inner chambers of spirituality? Here, the heavy burdens of destined baseness caused by past karmas are being untied. In its place, we are infusing goodness into our lives through action. This must be accomplished flawlessly. Consequently, one will wander due to numerous difficulties. If one prays along with the household, the whole household will wander.

Devotion has a tendency to become easily agitated. Once a person becomes thoroughly seasoned in Sattvic qualities, they will act with proper understanding. One who has not attained such maturity will get agitated like a fool. Such agitation leads to ruin. The character traits that are supposed to develop over many periods emerge all at once. Whatever good deed is done, a difficulty will always arise first.

For the sake of punctuality, sit for five minutes and pray through your work. Then, constantly fix it in your mind. When this happens, we will be showered with abuses. Illness will also come. Similarly, along with the spiritual vision, sorrow will also arrive. Whoever we see, the sorrow they experienced will affect us as well. Visions should not be spoken aloud for everyone to hear.

If a good deed is done, an opposition will arise against that good. When doing good, resistance will come. When taking steps to prevent the resistance, one becomes exhausted. Any kind of falsehood might be employed here. Considering this as the consequence of the service rendered, an opportunity should be given for correction. When unbearable pain arrives, instead of retreating from there, one must hold on with diplomacy. If one retreats, everything is lost. For example, how did R. Sankar fare among the community? How did Mannam fare? Mannam held on until the end. What was the reason he could hold on? He had a diplomatic approach among the common people. Sankar was not like that. He only thought about monumental things. He would not manage to get things done. He would not speak matters affectionately. Humility was significantly lacking in him. Because he lacked administrative diplomacy, Sankar employed statecraft. Statecraft alone cannot correct those at the grassroots level. Mannam was exactly the opposite.

Ezhavas and Nairs share the same predicament. They do not endure pain in spiritual matters. Nairs are a bit lower in this regard. What is the reason for this? Because they stood under the Brahmins, they could not bring it to their own homes. An elderly woman in the house chanting 'Narayana' with a mark of holy ash. Peons, document writers, village officers, subordinates—all of them apply the holy ash mark. And a dot above it. The pretense is that they are devotees. With this kind of devotion, there will be no hardship. But they do not know how to call out to God with a pained heart. There was a time when things were achieved even by frightening God. These poor people think that God is tied up with the string of fear. The belief is that if the battle between Bhadrakali and Darika is enacted, evil spirits will not enter the house for sixteen years! A face crafted in silver, dotted with rice flour and charcoal, dressed in Bhadrakali's attire with headgear and a sword. Seeing this itself induces fear. We do not have any of that here. Furthermore, there are no tests or miraculous powers here at all. However, the difference is that ours is spiritual, while the other is material.

All we have here is prayer. It is intended for the revival and sustenance of the world. To eradicate the impurities that have existed in our minds until today, and for the fruits of those actions to become ours, first pray, and then put it into practice. If you pray intensely, there will certainly be results. In some child born now, there will be the genesis that contributes to the revival of the world.
Guru Vani
Birthday Honored Dedication Edition 2005
The joyful operational capacity to convey the divine message

I speak to you with such authority to express my sorrow. You must understand the core of the grief I experienced when I began reforming so many people. Do not undertake this without realizing it. You have some kind of spiritual bond with me from the past. How is that? You might have assisted in penance, or perhaps your merit is that you poured a glass of water when I was walking by, utterly exhausted and hungry. Or it could have been some very small help offered during a time of hunger. When millions of people do this, there might be a hundred or so who gave it knowingly. They are the ones who experience this. You must perceive it in that way. You need to understand this. Otherwise, it is a love that humans cannot withstand. If you do not understand it this way, what can I do with you? We traveled to so many places and walked in so many ways. Somehow, we arrived here. In some small way, it might be lingering in some soul. That is what has come. Otherwise, it would not come. This is not something that is divided and distributed. The evolutionary theory of life is truly manifesting in all of us. When it is said that Buddha himself took 5,000 births, how many millions must we have taken! You will not understand this. Thus, through you, you are standing in a karma ordained for you by God. You must not waste it in vain. If you discard it, I cannot do anything. Those who stood by me, for ten, twenty, or twenty-five years, have fallen away over a single word. You will find yourself unable to do anything. Understanding this, let us take care not to corrupt our mind, words, and actions. That is the truth of the word. When that word becomes truth for us, it transforms into the Guru, into God. So, if you do not understand at least this much, there is no way for us to be saved. I have just told you about the situations of so many people. This is only one or two in a thousand. Most have gone in a way that they cannot be spoken of, touched, or stood by. Milk is good. But if it spoils, what use is it? All of you must understand this. It is good. This aspect of being good is an experience for everyone. There will be quite a few children who have this experience. By what I said, I do not mean that everyone will shine brightly. They will receive what they are entitled to. Then, if they make an effort and proceed without breaking their word, it will be fine. Otherwise, nothing can be done. Do not say you want this or do not want it. Why? Because if you say you do not want it, it will move far away. And it will not return. That is why I pointed out our Karnataka Swami. It is purely out of grace that the spirit of truth spoken of by Christ, or the light of that truth spoken of by Aurobindo, happened to you. There is nothing else to say about this. That is why, if you do not carry it with appropriate gravity, it is equally dangerous. You might take this lightly, and like boys and girls, you might just talk about some things for the sake of fun and entertainment. That is not permissible. It will lead to danger. They do it without understanding. It will push them to the brink of destruction. Therefore, all of you must keep this matter very true, and now a fulfillment has come to us in this manner. What is this the fulfillment of? Of nothing else. I said recently that there is a calculation mentioning up to the seven heavens. The calculation of Vedanta. The difficulties that arise when crossing beyond this cannot be described in words. It is after reaching this point that the Prophet, Moses, Aurobindo—and there are four or five other great souls like them—say, 'We truly do not know who this is.' This is the stage we must understand. This is a blissful functional energy that truly comes to you. Its name is bliss. When this bliss comes, we should not go and tell anyone. If you tell, it will not stay within you. It will be shaken off. That is why it is said that this should not be spoken of. Therefore, if you are fortunate enough to find this useful anywhere in your lifetime, you must perceive it truly and preserve it.

I am telling you, do not throw it away like this, dear ones; this is an opportunity. None of us will attain this merely by praying nominally. Then why are you being made to do this? It is to show you a fragment of the truth and then reclaim it. By reclaiming it, it is to pass on those karmic principles that went wrong, through us and through our children, to our future generations, however many may come. Today, not even half the time has passed since the world was created. It is said that it will be gone tomorrow. If asked why this Asia is fragmented into so many parts, it is because ice melted from various places and turned into water. Scholars among you say that the ocean covers more than half, or three-quarters, of the earth. It happened like this. This was diverted from the land. This is the melting of a massive iceberg. From time to time, it will melt and submerge things in this manner. This danger is not just for our country. It threatens the entire world. You must understand that the realm known as 'Patala' (the netherworld) actually exists on earth. Thus, the people in this Patala can also see this. Do not ruin this opportunity given by God to reclaim it. I will not be able to do anything. I am expressing this to you with deep regret. If those who come and stay here, those who come and go, and those who continually visit do not pay attention to this, what can you achieve? I am not sitting here to perform miracles. I have nothing to gain by making you believe in something else. The reason I am saying this is that this is a divine message that must be delivered through you and your children to this country, or wherever human beings exist in the world. This cannot happen except through your children. Guide your children properly and raise them to the best of your ability. After that, this is a recurring fortune for your country and simultaneously for all our lives. Do not try to cast this away. I cannot do anything. No one who has seen me will speak of sleight of hand, magic tricks, or any such displays. I have never even announced that I possess such a thing. You must understand this. Why did I not announce it? Why wasn't it made known that such a thing exists?

Disciple: The Guru himself did not know it initially, nor did those who stood beside him. It was later accomplished through disciples endowed with vision. In history, the only such incident we have known is regarding Kabir Das's Guru. He was unaware of his own greatness. It was when Kabir Das recognized it and told a Sattvic (pure) person that he was opposed to it; when the latter said it was impossible and asked him to leave, Kabir Das replied, 'No, if you permit me, I will do it,' and after he spoke a few words, it is said that the Sattvic person left the place. Considering that historical event, the greatness and stature of our Guru remained unknown to the Guru himself, and we came to know of it later through the efforts of subsequent disciples. If the greatness had not been brought to light in that manner, or if it had been known from the beginning, or if the Guru had pursued the path of scholarship, the error committed by the Acharyas of the past would have been repeated; he would have deviated from the path and failed to reach the state attained today.

Guru: Right now, you are only this many people. If we were to step into any given place, crores of people are waiting to come. But none of that is necessary. This is not a necessary matter at all. If you do not understand, act faithfully, step forward according to your abilities, and spread it across our country and to every part of the world, then I cannot do anything unless you handle it understanding that it is the guidance of the Word of God. Otherwise, this will just make people talk aimlessly, boast about the magnitude of mystical powers, and fragment God in the name of caste and religion. This is not a deed of love. Therefore, please, if all of you do not work in a path that is supremely loving, you will unknowingly be cast out. Nothing can be done about it. It's not just that it will be lost; it will also result in a life that we can never reclaim. Such a story lies hidden inside this. So, if men and women do not pay attention to those matters, what can I do? You will never be able to get it back. It will just keep shifting and go to some other country, eventually ending up in the hands of whoever safeguards it. You do not see it with that value. You are not realizing the precision of karma and the ultimate extent of the loving essence of merit at all. Why does this love enter your heart, and how should that love be sustained? It must be sustained by speaking the truth. Otherwise, it will not stay. Not only will it not stay, did you see that mother being called and shown? She knew it was the truth but did nothing. She didn't do it at a time of that fulfillment. That became the only outcome. This occurred in the incident where I said that the thing I had desired for ages was fulfilled. So, you understand this. Regarding divinity, there are still many stories that cannot be finished even if told for the past six, eight, or ten months. I am not saying this just to inform you in that manner. If it slips away completely without your knowledge, what will I do? I won't even be able to correct it. I am communicating this sorrow to you. You are entirely making a mistake that happens because you are unaware of its negative side and the karmic principle of its magnitude. How can I make you understand? There are so many people staying here with me. But they have no idea about this. What will I do? I cannot claim that they have any knowledge. Because, that is how they are showing themselves before me today. When I say this, you might think the people here are useless people who have all just come together to stand and destroy this. Do not presume that. I only said that they lack information about this subject. To the extent they can, as you see, struggling here day and night so much, have you seen people working like this in your life? You must think about it. You probably never thought about it in your life. Might not have seen it either. There are men and women here making such massive sacrifices. But because they do not know what they are doing, they are unable to realize its greatness and take a share of it. Like snipping away at it little by little, they make cuts here and there with their words. A large portion of their remaining fortune will simply crumble away. This fortune will not jump in front of you immediately. It will take three or four ٹ it will only spring before you in at least within a span of seven generations. That is when you will understand the way of the world. This special virtue, all of you should embrace it with love; it is not just for our land or our nation, it is a contribution made by God for the world. "Oh, we are not even aware of a truth that made us feel like rendering even a rust-mote worth of service, spending for it, struggling, and suffering for it. Whenever we are finally able to realize and adopt it, may we be able to share it with everyone with love and respect" - with this prayer, I implore all of you to safeguard it and engage with it knowingly, and with that, I shall conclude.
Guruvani
Birthday Commemorative Edition 2005
The mistake that can befall everyone if the true nature of the Guru is not understood

God has brought forth numerous great souls. How did Buddha himself, who arrived as the son of an emperor and became the authority of a noble karma, appear? There has been a history of slashing, stabbing, beheading, and massacring those who embraced Buddhism. What can you do about this? If anyone can do anything about it, they should speak up. He was a person who celebrated and propagated the Saranatrayas (the Three Refuges) in such a manner. Is it not so? Yet, where does it stand now?
Disciple: It gained strength through whatever system was adopted.
Guru: Yes. Do you agree with that?
Disciple: Certainly.

Guru: That is precisely what happened. Thus, whoever God entrusted this with to pass it on to us, we are the children who stand ready to destroy all of them and adopt an alternative path. Tell me it is not so. If I am stating falsehoods, you must question me.
Disciple: How can such a society be transformed?

Guru: This is an error that has universally afflicted everyone, not just a particular religion or a specific caste. When you observe this gradually, some people will be seen well-groomed and walking elegantly, while another walks like a destitute. You will simply ignore it, dismissing it as the way of the world. What will you do in this situation? Today, everyone must be striving in some manner to make their lives prosperous or better. This prosperity is what is being established here. What can be done? You suggest something yourself. It is meaningful only if we discuss it in a manner that you comprehend. There is no point in merely making statements. Let it be understandable to you.
Disciple: Everyone should unite and wage a struggle against unrighteousness.
Guru: My dear, how can that be accomplished? Do we not possess a lineage in which we were born and raised? Where can we go forsaking this?
Disciple: That is not a very simple task.

Guru: Yes, that is correct. No matter how much knowledge we employ, it will not work. No matter how much wealth is squandered for it, it will not work. No matter how much charity is done, it will not suffice. If this aligns anywhere within a human being, we must hold on to it there. There is no other justification. Therefore, the task is not to govern using these commoners, a few wealthy individuals, and a few scoundrels. Governing in such a manner will not succeed. The present condition is one of absolute collapse caused by the affluent. Tell me if you can say otherwise. You are at least somewhat educated. I am an uneducated person. Should we understand this or not? Through what shall we understand it? Speak to the best of your knowledge. Do not merely ponder and let it pass. There is no point in moving away from the position we currently stand in. Must we not begin from where we stand? Should we or should we not? So, that is what I am asking you. How is that possible?

I am not convinced that there is anyone among you who would say this is unnecessary. Then why have we become unable to embrace it, and how does this happen? — This is our shortcoming. It is only a minor aspect for us to comprehend. If you fail to understand it, what can be done? From the time we were born until today, we have not actively sought to embrace a flaw. Yet, somehow it creeps in. It affects us, those around us, the society, and the citizens. Why is this so? At one time, we all might have assumed that having wealth would change everything. That acquiring aristocracy would change everything. That attaining education would change everything. But it is only after acquiring these that we see their true consequences. You concede to that, do you not? There must be some preceding cause for this. There must be some karmic flaw somewhere that prevents us from grasping the reality. You can only move forward if you believe this. Otherwise, whatever you reconstruct will not turn out right. Without believing this, look at the immense exploitation we are currently engaged in just to fulfill our immediate selfish desires. Even now, the people who migrated to Arabia did not go there because we had freedom. We have plunged into a karma that operates by completely annihilating our freedom. Is this right or wrong? I am asking those of you who have gone there. I have not gone. So, we will indeed accumulate all these things. It is true, up to a certain limit. However, just like the acquisitions of life, this too will degrade. It is said that it will degrade in proportion to the acquisition. What is life acquiring now? India was once a place that possessed everything. Now, you are all people who teach history, are you not? Have you not seen the Somnath Temple, its destruction, its growth, and its survival? If a single Shiva lingam had that much weight in gems, why did we, the historians, end up like this? If I ask about the subject you teach, you must explain why it turned out this way.
Disciple: The lack of national unity is a primary factor.
Guru: That matter is true. However, merely stating that will not suffice.
Disciple: Is it because each era only looked after its own self-interests?

Guru: It shouldn't be stated in that manner either. We cannot claim that any human deliberately did so. However, some orphaned element will grow above our heads. What do you believe? What do you have to say? Speak from the level of your understanding. None of this is reflected in the language you speak. That is why I am stating this.
Disciple: It is an aspect that ordinary people do not comprehend.
Guru: Yes. The ordinary people do not need to understand. The question is, where do those whom we believe to be extraordinary stand?
Disciple: In a state of ignorance.

Guru: Exactly. They are serving it from a melancholic disposition where they are unable to articulate what is known and what is unknown. We are all experiencing this and speaking the truth about it. What can we do about this? I am sharing my experience. There are individuals who have been acquainted with me for forty years, and those who have lived alongside me for twenty-five years. I observe this disparity even in them. What should I say? I am not speaking of another's experience. To whom will this be entrusted? If you claim there is no experience, then what Narayana Guru states is correct.
Without a foundational experience, there can be
no inference initially through the eyes.
Because it has not been experienced, the existence of the entity
cannot be known through inference; it must be realized.

What is stated there is correct. But even having the experience, they do not listen. When we arrive late, arriving at sunset, going to a place devoid of light, what can be done? The people who have experienced it stand aside and hurl abuses. What to do? All these things I am saying are known to everyone here. There is no point in discussing individuality with someone who lacks experience. I am addressing an individual who has experience. The question is, what will be done there? Can we bring them back as a father, mother, husband, or wife? In the position they are brought into, they might falter. This is where I ask, what will be done? You are householders (Grihasthas). You must answer this. It is not enough for some ascetic lying somewhere to say it. There is no point in a Vedantin arguing over this either. There is no point in a seeker (Jijnasu) expressing all his special attributes. That is not what I require. What will you do about this? Shouldn't there be such an inquiry? It is when that inquiry arises and we reach a certain level that the setback occurs from there.
Disciple: There must be an elevation sufficient to overcome the setback.

Guru: It will only work if it exists, won't it! So, you are the instrument for it to exist. I am asking what can be done if this comes from you. I do not want to hear any justifications. No justification has worked here. Whether you speak of Advaita or Dvaita, or even the sciences of karma beyond that, it is something that has never happened to date. Only if you understand it that way can I say anything. We can take these renouncers as an example for that. We cannot consider anyone greater than the renouncers who have shown the way. Others might have just shown something and left. That is not what I am asking. Your mistake lies in the capacity for action of those whom you believe, love, and respect as renouncers. What will you do? For one, I have already mentioned Narayana Guru's case. Nothing can be done. Now, people have gone outside for some life interests, haven't they? If you ask what is happening there too, it is the same. It is not the absence of a philosophy. It existed, but they did not take it up. People think that by chiseling and polishing a clod of earth with all this, things will be set right. It will never be right. That is why, when the British ruled, in whatever ways and wherever they utilized their supremacy, there was only one thing everywhere - independence. This sense of independence has intruded into all human beings. Tell me it hasn't. What will you do with this? Will you chop it off? We have completely swallowed their freedom and are celebrating it. Is that true or false? This is what I am asking. This has arrived here by overriding the administration, the dharma full of sacrifice, and the greatness that humbly demonstrated what sacrifice is. Do you agree? This is what I am asking—what will you do? So, I can only speak of this to the extent of my knowledge. There might be much other knowledge. I am only speaking up to the limits of my knowledge.
Guruvani
Birthday Revered Dedication Edition 2005
How Will We Claim the Absolute Right of Sacrifice

As far as we are concerned, we hear a word called Manvantara. We have not studied the traditional arrival of this Manu and his spirit of dedication, and how it manifests here. Only India has such a calculation. Whatever else ٹ is added up, it will not go beyond eight thousand. Then how did this come to us? Speaking of the Manvantara that spans crores of years in our calculation, the authority of fourteen such Manvantaras has affected us, yet we cannot grasp it. Shouldn't we think like this? This is where we lack knowledge. I can only give you one piece of evidence for this. We have each taken the ideals of these great souls—that wealth—and ruined it. Is it true or not? Can we do anything else without conforming to this? What can be said to someone who does not conform? All of that came without intelligence, came without karma, came without dharma, came without merit, came without fortune. Agreed. All of this is agreed. How did this come about? We need to know this, don't we? What can be done? This is the same for us—it is a situation where everyone has given up. What will we do here?

I am also someone who came just like you. I do not know if I can say I have any special qualities. Furthermore, I can only make you hear a truth based on my experience. In the logic of the Hindu and the logic of religious prophets, when approaching that contemplative action called gross, subtle, cause, and effect, everything is a failure. What did you understand? This is what so many great souls have practiced. None of them left after sitting idly without acting. The absolute right of sacrifice resides in them. The truth is that not only were we unable to respect the greatness of life and that richness, but we were also unable to understand and act upon it. What can be done about this? We must return to where it stands. This is the summary. Therefore, running somewhere without finding that standing place is useless. This is what I have to tell you.

Thus, we become humans, devas, rishis, sannyasis, jnanis, bhaktas, and karmis. So, when speaking of this karmi, it refers to a householder (grihastha). Only he can perform karma here. What did you understand? No matter who acts—did you not see this, all these great people coming and running back? You have not seen this yet. Then what will I do?

This is entirely due to the lack of maturity in our life force. When born as a human, it is human freedom. Thus, each has its own freedom. If it is birds, it is their freedom. We must view it this way. Therefore, freedom is necessary for all living things. That can be understood through the course of life. Suppose this freedom has been transmitted to humans. This human does not hesitate to do anything for freedom. Forgetting all the love and respect held until then, this freedom is being fulfilled. This is a behavioral pattern of most human beings. What is that?
Disciple: That might be a part of striving for survival.

Guru: No. We are not a new life. We are, in fact, a very ancient life. As an example, dogs and cats are raised in certain homes. In some homes, they are raised with great comfort and joy. In others, they are kept at a distance. Yet, they continue to live there, considering it a home. Is that not the fortune of that life? If it is a dog raised by foreigners, they will take it along with them everywhere. Therefore, even to be born as a dog, a life requires good fortune. Similarly, when fortune favors our life, what do we generally do?
Disciple: Some become arrogant. Others humbly reflect a bit more.

Guru: Yes. For some, it is neither; they just live their lives without knowing anything. It is not that they are committing a crime; but they remain ignorant. Such a condition can be seen in our homes, our society, and our country. It is seen in individuals as well. Do we not need a specific action (karma) to bring about a change in such an individual? What would that be? Just tell me what you know.
Disciple: Other than the ordinary actions of an individual's life...?

Guru: No. It is required in the lives of individuals. Otherwise, what is the use to us if a great person's life merely exists like that? It is a truth that we must attain by living it ourselves, practicing dharma, and performing our karma. No one else standing by can substitute for it. Companionship is good. For what? It serves as a support and shade, helping us understand a little better, making us understand, and guiding us to lead our lives through it. That is good. However, if we do not regard that with due importance, it will be lost. It will slip out of our hands. All this is contained within the intrinsic tendencies (vasanas) of life. So, to transform these tendencies of life, we have seen only one approach so far. Everyone speaks of this Vedantic nature, saying that such is the nature of knowledge. But standing at the very end of this Vedic knowledge, what action can we possibly perform?

Disciple: What I have read in some texts is that in order to merge into the ultimate truth, one should renounce everything, abandon all material circumstances, live as a monk, and attain Nirvana without any action (karma). However, people like Buddha have proved that Nirvana is not a state of inaction, but rather a state of action.

Guru: Yes. Buddha is described as someone who attained closure through the hymns of Nirvana. But, in reality, Buddha was not like that. He completely entered the path of action (karma). Then, even after living like that, why did a flaw occur in that karma? Even taking alms in his own hands to live, this prince could not succeed. Even then, he was given poisoned food, caught cholera, and passed away. This is the history, isn't it? So, in this state, there is no directive on what we should do. This is where we are confused. Now take Narayana Guru, a person who lived in our recent times, and our lives are also in the nearby vicinity, right? Generally, even if the entire Chirayinkeezhu taluk lacked knowledge, there has been quite a change since the time of their birth. What do you feel regarding Varkala? What is the life of that land like?
Disciple: There has been a tremendous change in material circumstances. Correspondingly, there has been a moral degradation and a decline in values.
Guru: Yes. What is the reason for this to happen in a place where Narayana Guru attained Samadhi?
Disciple: It may be because there was an absence of a program of action based on moral values as intended by the Guru.

Guru: Not quite. That does exist, to some extent. This society of people must be knowledgeable. Earlier, we used the term 'establishment of Dharma'. So, what is our understanding of this establishment of Dharma? You are a householder (Grihastha). Children are the legacy left behind by a householder who lived well, behaved well, and did things properly. If a father, mother, children, husband, and wife live merely with wealth and lordship, where do we stand in terms of actions acquired through merit (punya)? Can that be bought with money? No. Then, just as we give offerings and gifts now, we give something to someone. That too can be given. But where will the merit of our life reach through this? Should we not understand that?
Disciple: I did not understand what you meant by a life of acquired merit.

Guru: We live as father, mother, children, husband, and wife, don't we? So, if the husband lacks adequate knowledge, in the context of the saying 'Bharya Bhajati Bhartaram' (the wife serves the husband), the wife should take control. If that wife lacks knowledge, the husband should take control. How should it be controlled? Only if there is mutual understanding can they agree by discussing it multiple times, saying 'isn't that enough,' or 'shouldn't it be like this.' Otherwise, for the sake of momentary prosperity, beauty, and fulfilling self-interests, they will argue and destroy it. Do you think otherwise?
Disciple: Mutual understanding is essential, indeed.

Guru: Mere understanding is not enough. In the position of the husband, it is said that 'the husband is God'. That is the Hindu principle. It is mostly the same in Islam as well. But this is absent only in Christianity. They are independent. It exists in Jainism too. What is it that we do not get in most areas? It is the deficiency in our life. Only rarely is a situation ordained for us to rectify this deficiency in life. It is wrong to think that everyone can just come and perfectly acquire all the virtuous qualities of life. It is not possible. It will be right only if you have wealth, authority, education, and the mental firmness to fulfill your desires. Otherwise, it will not work out. This firmness is not something that stays just because we hold onto it. It will be lost through a little agitation, a little emotion, or a little ignorance. This is where the ancientness of life is spoken of. This ancientness of life is not something we acquire through effort. It is a life measured and refined as if melted and purified over a long period, through many births. If such a life acquires merit over many births, and if we see that person as a guide or a thoughtful human being, we do not have the capability to grasp it. This is what has happened in Varkala and the Chirayinkeezhu taluk. Apart from wealth and authority, their standing in terms of knowledge is very small. Whom will they obey? They are worse than the British. They don't need laws, do they? Laws are only for those who want them, right? Why do they need laws? They prefer to remain completely undisciplined. Such a flaw has occurred not just in Varkala, but in the entire Chirayinkeezhu taluk. Is it right or wrong? If we take a clod of earth, rub it and knead it, and say it has become better because of this, I cannot believe it.
Guruvani
Birthday Revered Dedication Edition 2005
The Path of the Guide Who Attained Divine Nature

You cannot learn what kind of attention stands in that course of action (karma) where form and name are prepared. Then how do we do it? There is a way for us to learn it. There is no novelty in telling you about something that does not exist. We do not gain any knowledge from it. Although it is good to say that we have heard, known, and seen, we are in a helpless state where we cannot do anything about it. From the atom to how these five elements took form, from the time they became the five senses, there is a karma that has been known by tasting, touching, and smelling. We can speak of this only if we see how life has repeatedly fulfilled the evolutionary nature of that knowledge, which has come down to our present understanding since then. This is wisdom. So, through actions, we have seen some, taken some, and will take more. But nothing of this has really happened yet. We assume that everything is over. We haven't even reached halfway. What is yet to come will arrive suddenly and end. Therefore, before it arrives and ends, if we do not acquire this already existing knowledge, it will just pass before us without our knowing it. Therefore, the nature of knowing what we should do for this must come through our acquaintance and experience of knowing God purely as a human being. A Guru is one who speaks from seeing and knowing the karma where the structural variations of atoms stand transformed in all living beings—humans, God, deities, sages, and demons. Seeing and telling is not enough. In the experience of a disciple, what is made to be experienced by a person is seven and seventy experiences for one state. It transforms into seven hundred experiences. It also extends to seven thousand experiences. It is a single state.

Thus, having passed through each state, we must see it with our eyes. We must see deeper than what is seen by taking a photograph. Then, what is it? Because knowledge comes to us from within, we speak, understand, and tell each other. Otherwise, if our child is dull, and we say, "It's my child, let him not be dull," will it happen? We must know this. So, in the knowledge that human evolution has acquired, one must see where this path of dharma has reached the imaginative specialness of the course of karma, traveling as merit and sin. If we and our ancestors have seen the subtle bodies standing there, then our children must also see them. Instead of misleading us and destroying us, showing us the path truthfully, you should be convinced that you are the truth in that karma. Without being convinced of this, none of you can do anything. How will one be convinced? As said earlier about sleep, a person who appears to be sleeping like this. That is "Thoongamal thoongi" (sleeping without sleeping). We would think he is sleeping. But he is seeing how far the measure of time goes. Having seen that, as it transforms into births, a minor visionary speaks of the measure of that birth. For as long as that visionary says, we must practice it. Some will believe it. Some will not. Some will do it. Some will not. Some will find it and change. This is the mistake we have made to this day. What is it? The knowledge that came through each religion, they spoke like that. Like changing customs and tying them, like changing clothes, we changed and wore many things, learning and teaching, and we learned it through various languages in the nature of languages and the knowledge of letters. Those who have not studied the grammar of one language cannot believe that there is another grammar. Similarly, only if you have an experience of at least one thing, say a demon, can you believe that it exists over there. Thus, passing the demon and reaching the nature of the vampire (vetala), past those cities, we are seeing the thinking stage of a guide going to reach the divine nature. That is the special imagination. In this special imagination, in the dharma called "sankalpa karma manasa," life has the nature of a machine that intently watches what the dharma of the mind reached by your imagination is. The knowledge that climbs back to us on how we should take the dharma in that karma, which was imagined in the evolutionary nature of that life, are these children, husband, wife, wealth, lordship, and education. First, we must know what this is. So, knowing this and reaching the part of the knowledge of the aforementioned visionaries is the karma we need to know and take. Wherever mistakes occur, we should be shown them, and told what is what. To whom? To whom will we ask, "Why did you see it like this?" To someone who has experience seeing it; now, even a person who finds the parts of a bicycle and fits them together is a worker. Thus, after everything that runs through this sky and earth, it is said that he must see a particularity of knowing in which era this originated. This is dharma. Otherwise, everyone can say whether this exists or not. Our subject is not to make someone say whether it exists or not. A destruction has occurred in the acquisition of knowledge we have passed through. Rejecting this destruction and certainly bringing it to our betterment, the evolutionary state of life comes to us itself. Jesus speaks about finding such evolutions and knocking to open. But that same person asks, "Father, have you forsaken me?" What can we say to this? If there are any words to say that he was not a sacrifice and that he traveled in a wrong state, it is purely a negative statement. Similarly, they do not even know the karma of making good what all the scholars, the ignorant, and the prophets who have come to this day have said, after calling it bad. So that is not what is being said. What they all said is the truth. The question then is, through what will that truth be seen. So, where we speak of the gross, the subtle, the cause, and the effect, your Guru must reach that course of karma which your mind sees as the karma attained by you, your Guru, and your lineage in what you have achieved standing there. It is the Guru who shows it from there. No one else can do anything about this. So, to know what such a Guru is, one does not walk backward and forward. He sees and questions it there. This is an evolutionary nature. So, we must understand the extent of the course of karma that life has reached to this day. Otherwise, the strength to say "no" will arise from our ignorance. It doesn't matter. Anyone can speak and win. Or defeat. Do many things. We are speaking for neither of these. How we can interact and stay closely, what is the way for that—that is what is called the greatness of the Guru.
Guruvani
Birthday Worshipped Dedication Edition 2005
What will we earn in our knowledge through a special decree?
Disciple: Institutions of dharma truly need a leadership.

Guru: It is not enough to just want leadership; we must desire it. Just saying we want it is of no use. We will desire it and do any hardship or any action for it. In reality, what will it become? We assume that it is enough if we do a little prayer, a little sacrifice, and a little charity.

There exists a trajectory of karma that stands as though unauthorized, which does not manifest in us in this manner. I am not sure if you comprehended this. You learned, taught, imparted love, bestowed respect, and offered glory—whatever was required, you gave. Ordinarily, a father, mother, children, husband, wife, or teachers—regardless of who they are—offer things in this manner. Do they not? However, the manner in which they receive and apply it is entirely different. If this continues to grow and is accompanied by wealth and power, what would they not resort to?
Disciple: Arrogance will develop.

Guru: We do not know all that will happen due to arrogance. If degraded actions are committed in that state, where is the place of this dharma? Or, where is the place of that karma? What is to be gained by special rules? We can only act if we understand something of that sort. Regarding us, or regarding the human world today, apart from the fact that there are some differences on either side of human beings, there is nothing else. Apart from magnifying the divide between the rich and the poor or inciting class hatred, what else is there? Thus, it is this very human who must adopt this obedient nature. But he is unable to do so. When he cannot, what does he do? By increasing competitiveness, if he does not grow through another path, he will grow through caste. Overall, after growing through caste, it is common for everyone to claim that there is no caste, no religion, and no class. When they reach that position, how do they stand? We are all the remnants of a society that has grown by forming organizations based on this, making a living out of it, and thriving on such rhetoric.
Disciple: When caste-based atrocities occur, naturally one has to organize in the name of caste itself. I have my doubts regarding how true it is to call that mere casteism.
Guru: That is, scientifically speaking now, on what basis are you saying this?

Disciple: For instance, currently in our Kerala itself, members of the Pulaya community and members of the Ezhava community—thus there is a majority population that has been subjected to caste-based oppression. They had to organize as separate communities. They had to cooperate for freedom and rights against the interests of that elite class. Moreover, only those who constantly experience the problems of caste will have to speak about caste and organize along caste lines. Thus, it is not an effort to maintain that caste or to sustain that system, but rather an attempt to dismantle its framework and liberate themselves from it.
Guru: Yes. While attempting that, should this effort be allowed to become corrupt?
Disciple: Never.
Guru: That is what was stated. What can be done about it?
Disciple: The truth I have realized is that it does not merely contain a social or psychological fact.
Guru: Let it be whatever it is. Are you capable of standing apart from it?
Disciple: Circumstances that enable one to stand apart must be created.
Guru: How will that come into existence?
Disciple: Previously ٹ
Guru: There is no point in saying that. We are not discussing the past and the present.
Disciple: I merely pointed out that difference.

Guru: Before and after, we are all just the same. The reason for that is when there is wealth, power, and education, everyone is respectable. When these are absent, everyone is a plunderer. That is my understanding. If you have any other perspective, I cannot speak to that.
Disciple: Although it is true that they lack money, there is absolutely no necessity to become plunderers simply because they have no money.
Guru: There isn't. But, who is doing it now? From your own perspective, who is committing plunder? Is it the poor man who does not have the means to eat here who is committing plunder?
Disciple: It is the wealthy.
Guru: Then the question is, what will become of the children of this wealthy person if two generations pass in this manner.
Disciple: They will become greater plunderers.

Guru: That is all. There is no other issue. If you speak of scientific matters like that, this will not work. I do not believe it will work either. Why? When there is wealth and power, combined with great eloquence, sorrow, difficulty, and hardship, they will stand ready to agree with whatever he says. This is not the issue. How can we achieve this? If we think like this, what can be accomplished by singing praises, flaunting the opulence of education, or displaying the excess of wealth in the actions you perform today? How will you tell the children? Where will you take it to tell them? We must understand that, shouldn't we? The plunderers of today are those who possess education, wealth, and aristocracy. No one can set that aside. No government can do anything about it.
Disciple: What if they are brought onto the right path right from the beginning?
Guru: Do any of us desire not to have the right path?
Disciple: Usually, it is more commonly seen that the children of plunderers become plunderers and the children of good people become good people.
Guru: That is seen more. What exactly is this 'good'?
Disciple: Doing good deeds.

Guru: For whom is this good deed being done? Who acts with the intention of doing something evil now? Even the plunderer is doing what he considers a good deed. If necessary, he will say, "I gave to this many people." Is that bad? Did he not give to the needy! I am not talking about any of this. What was asked is how this goodness is sought, achieved through action, and undertaken without dragging it into karma and spoiling it. We all say this, I cannot say there is a single child who says we do not need anyone. None of us will admit that we are wrong either. People will say that in whatever they do, some rights and some wrongs have occurred. There is right and wrong. We have it too. Everyone has it. Having said that, what can be done? Isn't it enough to say that it is customary for it to happen that way?
Disciple: We must develop such an awareness. Once a person enters into spiritual leadership, in every era, there usually comes a person considered to belong to that respective time ٹ preceptors.
Guru: Yes. Although that has come, we do not have the knowledge to accept it. That is where the problem lies.
Disciple: Standing without the knowledge to accept a preceptor is not a temporary phenomenon. Even in the history of the preceptors who have come and gone up to this day, such problems have occurred.

Guru: Yes. Tell me what is being taken. The world history that you have studied, and what another person has studied, is today in the hands of Christian missionaries. Is it not? What good have they done for this world?
Disciple: The Guru is speaking about the decay that occurred in ancient times.
Guru: Yes. Exactly that.
Disciple: In the early periods, it was undeniably a liberation movement for a vast section of the population.
Guru: What has it become now?
Disciple: It has become corrupted and has reached a state of action that causes harm to the vast majority of people.
Guru: The question is how you will change this.
Disciple: What if we adopt the path of another Yugapurusha (Avatar of the Age)?
Guru: Shouldn't we first recognize him as a Yugapurusha?
Disciple: Absolutely, we must.

Guru: Otherwise, if you hand a stick over to an ignorant person, he will strike everywhere unnecessarily. It is the same if you give him money. It is the same whatever knowledge you impart to him. He will roll it around in unwanted places. What will you do about this? What do you think you and I can do here regarding this?
Disciple: We can approach this with a new philosophy and a new action plan.
Guru: My dear, shouldn't there be people here who can attune themselves to this philosophy and action plan?
Disciple: In all circumstances, there will be a few who are compatible with it.

Guru: All that is true. But whatever it is, is there anything more to be said than the sacrifice shown by Buddha, the sacrifice shown by Jesus, or the sacrifice of the Prophet, who proclaimed until the end that there is nothing other than You?
Guruvani
Birthday Commemorative Dedication Issue 2005
Service must be shared as God's own

The people of this land know me. Especially, we started this hospital in a state where the people living in our ashram environment, or living around here—all the people who are alive—were unable to assess the purpose of our hospital. But it is a kind of, as people say, like a worm crawling and forming a letter, it is like that. None of you should assume that this was due to the foresight or contrivance of any of us. Moreover, from that day to this, there is a working capacity demonstrated by the men and women who have come to work in the hospital, knowingly or unknowingly. Those who come in the future must recognize this and progress at the pace of that understanding. That is why I am saying this. What is it? This was brought to fruition by making ignorant youths and people with no connection to medicine do it. But they were not only brought to get it done, they were also given the responsibility and made to do it. Therefore, every individual who has worked here since then knows that they can do and get anything done. This is the part called healthcare service. The healthcare service that we have heard of is not something we do in the manner of today's government service or with the character of a private hospital. We can do that too. But that is not it. Our service, the service rendered by the men and women here, must have God's approval. We should not do it with the arrogant attitude that we are serving someone. We are serving the people. By setting up an institution, taking it upon ourselves, and doing it ourselves, a complete dedication to the world must come through us; it must reach the whole world. This should be our goal. It should not turn into a competition for sharing money and wealth. There is one good thing here, two or three groups have told me. People who were our inmates came to the hospital for treatment. Not inmates, householder disciples. Then they asked these children, what kind of sweeper or super are you? They did not give any reply to that. Later a woman came and said, none of you are qualified to ask us this. Whoever said that, it is a great thing. Because, we are doing a service according to our knowledge and our experience. So there is no need for you to talk about sweepers and supers. Here no one is in the authority of a superintendent. If you are trying to destroy the freedom of us doing a service, then there is no point in your coming here. With that single word, he didn't want to hear anymore. The recognition of your service is what the people who come and experience the healthcare say through your actions. Rather than, as you say, some quacks putting things together—there are such times too. We don't need to explain and show any of that. As far as we are concerned, the service of an ashram means this, it is to show this. So even if not all of us have understood what ashram service means, I have tried to make those who listen to me do it as much as possible. There are people who have started showing that they don't want it, or that it is beneath their dignity, that they are not this and that. They have also learned it as such. But that is not what we need. As far as we are concerned, we have nothing to gain by fighting and winning like this. What we have to gain is to ensure our service reaches whoever it can reach. It doesn't matter if they are great or poor, or a beggar or a destitute. What does a destitute know? He doesn't know. What can a beggar do? But we must handle it without thinking about any of that.

It is getting it done through you to the best of my ability. I have not called a single child here for anything else. This is something that came into being like tying together broken threads, moistening them so they do not break, and tightening them securely. We have not prepared this by forcing anyone to do it through scolding, or to belittle anything for any reason. Similarly, all the boys standing here now—the boys who just arrived do not know—did not receive that much knowledge for it; but they have also come to realize that this is how it is. So, those who came as Vaidyas (physicians) and others are also doing exactly that. Even now, they are doing the same. But they have had to bear a greater responsibility, and all those who have come as Vaidyas or doctors have had to demonstrate a bit more sincerity and incorporate more of their dedicated service. Henceforth, their service is being utilized so that this continues and grows ten or a hundred times over. I did not come in a manner of knowing all this, nor was it something I acquired. Everyone who knows me is aware of this. I did not come that way at all. We have not done anything to merely show that all the functional capabilities of an ashram are like this. The tradition of an ashram, at most, involves completing recitations, followed by meditation and chanting, and building an environment of teaching and learning Vedic hymns, or becoming what is known as Chaturvedi, Dvivedi, or Trivedi. We have not taken the trouble for any of that. The reason for this is that no matter what we do, earn, and live in obedience here now, many people are already doing such things. Currently, it is being done in many places in Kerala itself. Today, it is happening in Thiruvananthapuram as well. None of that is part of our desire. We will utilize it. But the service that aligns with our desire is to do whatever we can to the best of our knowledge, without causing pain to human beings. The locals know this to this day. They have tried to hurt us in many ways. But it did not feel like a pain to me. I doubt whether their ignorance was exposed before this divine will, and they ended up trapped in their lack of knowledge. If they get trapped like that, it is our loss. Why? If they could not embrace the decency of this land, what is the use of them being the natives of this place? What is the use of them being the people of this country, this taluk, or this district? There is no use at all. They are incapable of anything other than living in a state of animalistic thirst that accumulates emptiness. The growing children must understand this at least in the future. The reason I am saying this is that I am not just making things up here. I came here to lay a foundation stone for this. After that, the next morning, someone who was with me and I came here. While we were returning, there were about fifty children there. At that time, it was impossible to find that many children gathered together there. There was no proper wall built then. A lot of rocks were collected and stacked outside. They sat on it with their backs turned, waving, laughing, playing, and then they showed some mischief. This is the remnant of the knowledge here. Those children are the remnants of what the people here have understood. What can be done? But today, they have started feeling that it was not like that. It is good that they are feeling this. It is not just for their future; at least their children will have an opportunity to say that there is an institution in our land that desires and works for the betterment of the coming generations. For that opportunity, the work we do here, or the work we do in the name of this ashram, or whatever we do as a service, is a noble deed. If we adopt this model, we can pave a model of service just as the path of truth is paved. There are girls and boys providing service here today. If each of you—whether patients or visitors—goes and observes them, you will realize that they did not learn this formally with academic knowledge. However, they are serving with an understanding that goes beyond mere knowledge. That means, such an attitude of service has developed through our familiarity here. You should not share it as your own, but rather as something from God. Otherwise, that service is not right.
Guruvani
Birthday Commemorative Dedication Edition 2005
The Path of Perfect and Supreme Sacrifice

Humanity as a whole lacks a sense of Dharma (righteousness). Let that be. Nothing can be said to these absolute fools masquerading as scholars who try to drag humanity into an idiocy incapable of even recognizing the flaws in Karma (action). There is no point in talking to them. They are merely destined to perish, be born, and die entirely. There is no use paying attention to them. We do not need to absorb them into our intellect. Nor should we look for good in them. Let them remain as they are. We should not even attempt to reform them. If we try to reform them, we too will become corrupted. So, what if you stand firm like that? You must be thoroughly vigilant in your actions, and when another person experiences it and behaves with humility towards us, it should be transmitted to the world through him. That is our goal. You must never act forsaking this goal. Boys and girls, similarly, are sent here and taught in this manner. You should not send children here thinking they can absorb something else. To absorb anything from here, doing what has just been said is sufficient. One cannot simply teach or dictate karmic capability. All of that is a karma situated in a lowly state that needs to grasp your fortune and divine favor. That karma cannot be imparted to others. Individuals must absorb it themselves. Therefore, this is exactly what every realization teaches us, instills dharma in us, sanctifies us, and leads us to good fortune. Everything says exactly this.

So, understanding this, at least some of you have said that there is no one here to see the work you have done and questioned why you are doing this. You have said that after doing this, there is no one here to ask why you did it. But the absence of people (to praise you) is your goodness. Why? You should not fall into a state of dharma where probing and bothering you turns into arrogance, and the struggle of that arrogance leads you into cruelty. Such a 'dharma' will always pave the way for destruction. That is not what I have done. They too should feel, if they wish, that this is their karma to ask and speak, and that the continuous vigilance they must maintain is a dharma they have received for the rest of their lives, which they will embrace without squandering. If they feel so, it is everyone's good fortune, and each of us can experience a share of it. We must perceive it in the name of God. When it is in the name of God, none of us need to harbor a sense of discrimination or division. Nor do we need to take upon ourselves any karmic flaw. That is the only path I can request of you today to follow. Other than praying further that you develop a good mind to ensure you do not destroy the convenience God has given you to do things, make others do things, and achieve things, there is nothing else I can do.

Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra—my necessity is not merely to share with the world this karma revealed by God to impart dharma to my children and the world, a karmic potential capable of incinerating all the flaws and detriments in this Shudra phase. We must envision it functioning flawlessly in every atom of ours, operating as a sphere of fire. We should not pursue anything else. It is incorrect. This is what I have to state. He is an educated individual. A person who resided outside. He also lives and learns with dignity. However, I brought him here not for the experience he has lived. The karma you must execute there is to enable him to comprehend what your service entails and what he ought to do here, to acquire everything we are meant to receive through him, and to impart our service to him, instilling the courage to share it with the world. You are all somewhat aware of this. But you must implement it. It took this much time after I said I would come to explain this karma. Therefore, if this karma is to be concluded only upon leaving the physical body, let it be so; I have no grievance regarding that. Every one of you must develop such courage. We must depart, leaving the virtue of this endeavor to our lineage. This is our objective and the path of absolute sacrifice that must be nurtured through attainment, love, and reverence. We shall transform into guides for that.

Why was all this stated? Everyone must understand. We must believe that what all of us are collectively doing on that path is entirely for the benevolence of the world alone. It is not merely for our own good. This will spread into the world. How? How did the British enter here? If they arrived with an intent to harvest—whom are they harvesting? Us; but we are meant to offer that harvest to them in a different manner. To offer it as a service. They harmed us. We must defeat them through another aspect. These Mughals and the aforementioned British are the administrative regimes known to us in recent times. We must not commit any of the acts they did. We must serve them and whatever mischief lies beyond them; by serving them, we must lead them to God. It is not for us to attain merit by bringing it to ourselves. That is not the path of God. Let them reach God. Let them receive whatever they are meant to receive from there. This is our goal. Not even a child among you should act deviating from this goal. We do not require that. Because here, when some people bought pieces of cloth for the children, they refused them. You should not view that as a great credit. We are not permitted to do so. We do not desire that path. Otherwise, if something is to be done, all of us collectively do it in a way that benefits a common gathering. You should also contribute as a part of that. Apart from this, do not accept anything from them and make it our wealth. If we accept ten paise from them, we will incur a loss of eight paise. It is not needed. They need not come to offer us charity. Provide them with service and send them out. You came desiring a good life. But, you will know it. You also know how to act. Any trivial act could destroy it entirely. Do not do that. Do not do so through a word or by making a slight noise. Stating this while seating you here is because it is the karmic flaw of someone who has accompanied us. You must reform them by saying, 'Please do not do that, sir.' That is your responsibility. Otherwise, even upon death, it will not leave his soul. Because, isn't this life experience? It adheres to his soul, and even if this life perishes, it will not be destroyed. It will remain as a flaw.

Where will the possessor of this malevolent mind reach, who upon seeing their service is unable to say, 'I must be able to do something in this, what should I do, you must ask if you need any of my assistance'? One must depart only after demonstrating it. You know where one will go. I have attempted many times to say a good word to you. I did not get the opportunity. Today, I am utilizing this as an opportunity. All of you must receive it with love, respect, and reverence, transform it into virtue, and offer it to others. Let them earn through that virtue, become fortunate, and let that fortune merge into whatever resides as the controller of this universe. This is my proposition. We do not require an administrative system of this kind or independent knowledge of this nature. Our independence is the ownership of a great karma that offers love and reverence to God and earns respect through devotion. All of you must be able to comprehend that. It is in the purity of life that our girls, the segment referred to as the women of ancient Bharat, have received the Kali Yuga as an era to shine most splendidly. However, it grew corrupt like a compass pointing West, and not knowing what to do, their task became wandering here and there with the array of papers they studied, delivering some speeches, and sitting like an MD with one leg crossed over the other. None of these practices should enter among us here. You must not desire to replicate the instinct for violence in the same manner. If desired, all the work we do will become like drawing on water. Therefore, this is not our necessity. Now, the girls who have come here, or the elders, are not permitted to do anything of this sort. Nor do they do so. I consider that a fortune.

The karmic capability that functions as workers and as the wealthy must become entirely our own. It does not belong to anyone else. It is by attaining purity in actions aligned with divine justice and reaching the karma where purity must be demonstrated, that this karma transitions into virtue and is offered to God. It is not that you undertake and perform it by yourselves. Only if you have that understanding can this be executed. Otherwise, do you know what will happen to you? You will discard it and leave, claiming, 'I have done this much, I have seen it all.' That must not occur within you. The experience and capability to do this much have come to you. You must not cast it away and depart. If you leave, you will find no salvation. It was given to you by God—if you ever thought even once that it was given by me, it will not endure. It is not given by me. It was bestowed upon you by God Himself. You cannot go and acquire this opportunity anywhere else. It was God who gave it to you. It cannot be achieved if I give it to you, or if the emperor here sits in penance and grants it. That is not what I am telling you. Before you leave this body after practicing and working to the fullest extent on this glory bestowed by God, we should not even get an opportunity to think or speak a single word contrary to it. Before that, when our life departs from this body, we are the ones who must leave it as an inheritance in this world for those noble births as well. After departing in such a manner, if anyone is to arrive as rightful heirs to execute any truth in this world, it will be our soul.
Guruvani
Birthday Revered Dedication Edition 2005
The Grihastha Dharma of Recognizing the Fortune Decreed by God

The devotees of Narayana Guru must reflect upon their inherent worth. There is lamentation that not a single child is awakening spiritually. Consequently, it is observed that contemplating this now is insufficient—one ought to have considered raising five or six more children earlier. What purpose do they serve? These are words spoken in the final stages. They have not been permitted to accomplish anything. Today, they are all devotees of the Swami. When I state this, can any of you speak merely to appease me? This is what has been observed and learned. I have never desired any of this. I did not act out of a desire for this. My message to you is that you must not squander this time bestowed upon you by God. What does that entail? The phenomena we have hitherto only heard about—such as visions, apparitions, or disembodied voices—are now being actualized in the experiences of your children.

I am not drawing you closer by displaying miracles. That is not my way; may such things never come to me. May God prevent them. That is my sole prayer. What we hold in our hands are the ancestral karmic actions that have striven to prevent householders (*Grihasthashramis*) from attaining this. That is, it has even been decreed that householders are forbidden from engaging in any of this. They have been made to believe that a householder does not need to know what an ascetic (*Sanyasi*), an active worker (*Karmi*), or a wise person (*Jnani*) is. This is the fallacy prevailing among you. On the contrary, being a householder signifies being an individual who perceives reality directly. You did not understand that, did you? That is, isn't the child seeing it now? Are they not your children? The children perceive it. Can you ask, "Why can't I see it?" His father asks, "Why can't I see it?" If you say, "You are uttering lies," what can I say? Similarly, if her husband and everyone else ask me, "What is this, am I not her husband, why can't I see it?" what shall I reply? If you ask, "Are we not the child's parents? Why do you say this is forbidden for us?" what should I say? This is not anyone's personal prowess. It is a fortune destined for you by God. You must become capable of receiving this fortune. It is insufficient if only I am capable. If I accomplish this for you, you must dedicate children to me who can preserve it until the end. Is it not so? Therefore, it is you, the children living as householders, who are needed. They must undertake this. Through their progeny, this imparts goodness to the ancestors, deities, sages, ascetics, and the souls claiming liberation, who have been faltering until now. If this goodness is imparted, it will be fully realized by our seventh generation. It will only be perfected by the seventh generation. Once you experience this, honoring and adopting it is your responsibility. It is not for me to do. Apart from the fact that God has granted me permission, I cannot tell you anything else. I can facilitate it for you. You are the ones qualified to receive it. I would not suggest anything that you cannot pay attention to, would I? Have I ever spoken thus? Did you hear? I will not say such things. Now, this did not occur because the child desired to become an ascetic, or because you desired it. In her life, she does not know if this is raw or ripe. A young child. She lacks even ordinary worldly intellect. She does not possess a crooked mind. She only possesses a straightforward mind. It is this child who has received this. Thus, in the exact same manner, the family members in the householder stage are receiving it. If you ask me about receiving this, I can provide an answer, but it is you who must realize it. Is that right or wrong? My task is merely to call upon you and state the truth; my work is not to mislead you along a path for invaluable wealth by making you believe that you will receive grand arrangements, great visions, or huge lumps of gold. I will not make such claims. This is something bestowed upon you by God. How should you receive it? You do not even know. Therefore, this is not something we can purchase with money. Your lineage of children does not comprehend what this is. What can I do? This cannot be preserved in your home.

You have had the fortune to receive it! You must inquire into the reason for it, and even if we do not reach its full extent through association, each of you must possess the ability to preserve it as the truth. Must you not? Is it enough if I do it? This is my perspective. I am not drawing you closer by performing miracles. I will not exhibit such methods. Nor have I ever exhibited them. May God never grant me an opportunity for that. So, you are receiving all this. That is true. You can only perceive this through a person who has the rightful claim to it. A person with such a rightful claim is being revealed to you. You may accept that person according to your own understanding of how they should be received; this is not a matter confined to a story narrated by someone. If the ancestral purity of our forebears, or divine purity—the deity they worshipped—is not rectified and aligned, this will collapse midway. Do you remember it being said that the Shudra class will not understand this? That itself is the ignorance prevailing among our people, where arrogance is displayed and wealth is wasted merely to misinterpret and ruin this.

We must evaluate this path of truth as something that imparts goodness to those born as humans like you, or even to all living creatures. The reason I constantly speak to you is for all of us to uniformly understand that this has never been transmitted through any caste, religion, or class thus far. Is it not your responsibility to implement this completely? Instead, no one should allow you to be led down a corrupt path by uttering trivial words. This is not something one can witness by merely walking through an entire lifetime. You must comprehend and practice this. Even if one listens for an entire lifetime, it is impossible to hear this completely. Is it possible? Many people come here and display their affection and respect in various ways. However, you must understand one thing. If a word is spoken incorrectly, you must rectify it immediately. Obey, act, and assimilate. Nothing else is required. Do not behave in a manner devoid of dignity. Do not speak excessively. Sometimes, we may not find the time. We must act by visualizing ten years ahead, contemplating and performing each action mentally, envisioning that it should manifest in a specific concept and specific manner. For those ten years, we are merely working. After ten years, it will reach our intended destination. Our conception then elevates further and further. When we achieve that, it will ascend to another level. This is how it functions. Human conception possesses such a capability.

You must keep your word. There is a predicament in it that will not stop even if I attempt to obstruct it. That is why it was said that those who do not uphold their word truthfully should not undertake this. The word is truth. When we experience that truth, it becomes the Guru. When it is experienced yet again, it becomes God. What you are doing to me, the one who has guided each of you to this karmic duty, is the exact opposite. I cannot refrain from telling you this. Do not assume that this is being addressed to newcomers. But it is indeed to them. Because, if they are merely believing, coming, and going in this manner, it is sufficient that you believe after understanding the nature of the place you are visiting. Otherwise, there is no need to create a stench like someone pointlessly carrying fish tied to their shoulders. You must understand what needs to be done with this. I am expressing my agony to you. You are aware that there is no limit to the abuses I have endured thus far. I am telling you this after having heard and known such abuses over twenty-nine years.

Have those who believed gone wrong? I do not see it as their fault either. What is it? We are the children born in that zodiac where we do not know whether it is a divine system that had a slight flaw in its mythological authorship in the past, or in which lineage it aligns. What can be done? This is why I tell you after having done it for you, do not do it again in return. I am truthfully telling you something that has come to my knowledge. You do not need to do anything else. Just be mindful of the words you speak. You must not do anything that would corrupt me, you, and the generations to come by participating in this.
