Because I have removed it. This is Gurupooja. It does not happen everywhere. So, we have managed to do it that way. But there is no one to take it back. What is the use of making me do this? You all believe that I know this. I have a sorrow that, in accordance with your knowledge that is so many years old, you could not come forward as children and children's children. Whom will I tell other than you? That is why, even though this body of mine is in such a bad condition and I am so unwell, I am speaking to you like this. The person speaking is someone who is unable to utter a word. But there is sorrow. There is pain.

Please, those of you who are present and those who are yet to join, kindly believe that we are preparing our children to remove a part of a karma that we have been experiencing for so many Chaturyugas (four-age cycles). Otherwise, we cannot do anything. Because we have grown this much and reached this age. What will you do now? Not that. If the children to be born and the parents to be born do not live truthfully, what can I do? It will be exactly like washing it away in the water. Therefore, at least those of you who have performed this act called Gurupooja should tell each of your children to preserve it carefully. Otherwise, I cannot do anything. It is not something that will change just because you change it. I do not have the strength to believe until today that anyone else will change it. I am telling you this conclusively. You know that too.
Guru Vani
Birthday Revered Dedication Edition 2005
The Evolution of Knowledge Beyond Thought

If all our forms exist like this, how does it stand in the gross state, how does it stand in the gross, subtle, and causal states, how should we take back that karma—the one who teaches this is the Guru. You must ask only after seeing it; you should not question it by doing acrobatics with words. This is not that. Yesterday, or just like that, an ignorance came to me. I have my mind, I have my karma. Or rather, there is no deficiency in the body. But when it comes to consciousness, an ignorance has crept in. If asked "What is it?", the familiarity that explains it, its medium, has led us through various paths today. One loses consciousness, one becomes ignorant despite having consciousness, another speaks nonsense after expressing all consciousness. So, he knows this. Even if he is crazy, he blabbers about the special things he knows. So, the knowledge of what this crazy person is blabbering about is what we see as madness. What the knowledge that stands beyond that madness is, can be seen as worldly madness too. Or else, it can be seen as a worldly drama. In the karma that takes place within this drama of the world, who is each one of us? What obligation do we have? In the dharma that we must reach through our lives, from our little children onwards, we are born and we die—or say there is no birth and no death; such people have no authority to speak about visionaries. Why do they say that? Therefore, do not say both together. Say only one. You should only strive to explain the evolution of that one. There is no merit in saying it doesn't exist without knowing anything, or saying it does exist without knowing anything. This is the Guru. What kind of Guru is that? There should be a Guru who can take us at least up to the devil. What is it? Is he not human? Then why take us to the devil? If we do not know what that devil is, we will end up in actions celebrating that it does not exist. But when they progressed by knowing like us, they say "Vethala Nagaram Batha" (Alas, the city of ghouls). Climbing up from there, starting with the Trinity system and the Mother, and reaching the karma called Allah, after completing that dharma or Shaktheyam, Shaivam, Vaishnavam, what stands in the place of gross, subtle, cause, and effect—the one who teaches this course of karma is the Guru. Thus, being interpreted through letters that no such karma exists, or by following the path of eminent scholars who have come through ages of writing, studying, listening, and knowing, we end up discovering it in such a wonder-inducing karma. Then God is seen like that. Taking out things wonderfully from the sky and the earth like that. But nothing can be taken out that does not exist in this earth and sky. That is the truth of it. So, it exists. It is there somewhere. It can be taken from there. That is not a big deal. That is not what you should obey. We have it. Suppose we get a gold block the size of Kerala. What should we do? Will we just take it and swallow it? So, it is not like that. How has that gold undergone its evolutionary nature? Coming back like that and changing it into its tools, who are we as far as that karma is concerned? Thus, transformed into these five elements, disguised as the five senses, trapped in the knowledge of the five sheaths, in the karma discovered through those nine lights, combined with toxic and non-toxic goods and united through yoga, who is greater among them? This is our thought. So, this has taken a different path. It is said in the language of another scholar that he is the one who discovered the dharma of this world. What is it? Carpenter, bell-metal worker, blacksmith, goldsmith. Another knowledge we have is that they have been practicing it for that. Then they brought him, gave him a different knowledge, and did another job there too. They gave him a chanting thread too. Let it be there. But it is through the left side. The right side is for this intelligent one. How will we know the dharma of this karma where deceit, lies, and truth are mixed together? First, you must believe that all these exist—knowingly or unknowingly. No one needs to show this to us anymore. But now, moving towards the realm of knowledge that only tells us the mistakes and good deeds we have seen so far is what is called lightness and heaviness. The previously mentioned Guru must teach us the course of karma that takes such lightness. There is a state we see sitting with our eyes open and closed. Bringing us to this point, separating us from there, and telling us that you can achieve this state only if you combine these things—that Guru must teach this. So, it is not enough to do it for one or two. Going on and on like that, performing millions of courageous karmic acts, we just need to discover the greatness kept before us and work in alignment with that greatness. We don't need to go back anymore. All those things definitely exist. Now it is not difficult for us. We don't need to search elsewhere to learn the names of tools or things. God has also given us the intelligence to take them by blending love and respect in the respective spheres where we have seen, heard, known, and studied everything in our language and reached the position of knowledge. It is this love that we must discover. This is the Guru.

Therefore, such Guru-hood must be imparted to you. Having imparted this, whatever be the Dharma mentioned—be it of a prophet or anything else. Or be it five thousand; that too is acceptable. But it is not like that. The Dharma of Kali, which is said to span 4,32,000 years, is a cycle of time that is completed by five Gurus. Beneath that, there are many thousands, hundreds of thousands of Mahatmas who attain the second, third, fourth, and fifth states. It is not that, because we only mention the names of twenty-seven stars. But it catches our very eyes—how many crores of stars do we see directly? Thus, if you think like this, it is not something you can easily grasp. Therefore, you should know about the Karma connected to these twenty-seven stars. Reaching up to that Karma, experiencing and learning it as gross, subtle, causal, and effective, is our human Dharma. Realizing that man is a symbol who becomes a Deva, a Rishi, a Sanyasi, a Jnani, and thus a prophet and everything else, respecting that greatness and trying to learn it is the truth called Darshana. This is Darshana. Not the Darshana written down by someone based on their whims. Therefore, in such a Darshana, one must recognize whether the subtle course of Karma seeks merit or involves deceit and betrayal leading to danger. Having realized this, it must be explained to you. This is its essence. Therefore, only after saying that much and seeing that much can one become a Guru. Otherwise, one cannot. He is not a Guru. He is neither the seed nor the flesh of a fruit. He is nothing. Therefore, if you believe that the evolutionary nature of life capable of grasping such greatness resides in each of you, I too have the interest to inquire, to know, and to make known. You also have the right to inquire into what I should do. Inquire and find that out. This is its aspect. You should not reach that Karma which destroys you by preaching non-existent things in the name of Vedanta, leading up to 'Swaha'. That would be swallowing the axe of utter foolishness. It is destruction. Do not do so. I can say this with absolute certainty. What is it, it is not acceptable to say that I am lying. There might be someone traveling on the same path as mine. Similarly, there must be someone who has experienced through me. Otherwise, there is no need for any of us to boast by talking about other things.

Therefore, we should know about the Karma that is told to us by turning back after reaching up to the Lord of the Ganas. This is the subject. So, understanding this subject, we should impart it to our children only in this manner. We cannot attain this merely by studying the Shastras. You must also believe the truth that both men and women can achieve this. There is no point in making you believe by saying things that do not exist. Nor is there any point in stating something you cannot discover. It is not so. In our human Dharma, we who are born at the beginning of this Kali yuga are fully entitled to it. That is Kali. Stirring and clearing the rights and wrongs that have occurred to date—that is the Guru. By stirring and clearing it, showing 'Look, there is such a mistake here.' This is being taught. It does not matter whether one is male or female, young or old. There is no point in boasting about caste and religion for that. There is nothing in it other than the pure manifestation of a blunder. It will be like the Dharma of an unbeliever. He cannot attain it. Therefore, if we have any personality that tries to learn by saying it does not exist, reveling in a personality that does not tell the truth to us or to its own life, in the act of destroying a poor brainless donkey, then in each such Dharma, we are entirely discovering a truth of humanity. We gain nothing by saying that this man is bad, or that he is somewhat good. We must only have the fortune to achieve this. In such fortune, we are seeking a course of Karma that each of us can take with absolute humility. We must be able to do this. This must be achieved while remaining a human being. Otherwise, there is no point in talking big about a Karma attained in the afterlife; God has given us the knowledge to grasp it in the light of a truth that can be known and attained by us while we are still alive. We must not fall short in that knowledge which we share as individuals. That is the intent of the greatness we have spoken, heard, and known with each other to this day. If we cannot manage to grasp this, we can do nothing except talk about something. You must realize that this is a truth achievable by human beings. Therefore, it should be known in the aforementioned manner. That is known. We will all reach the realm of such knowledge at some point or another. Because it is achieved only in accordance with our evolution of knowledge. We cannot attain it by doing anything else. Thus, the evolution of that knowledge reaches a point beyond thought, and sees the reality that transcends thought, regarding the evolution of life. Witnessing such reality, what we see is the glory of the form of light where the humility of love and respect is imparted. Whoever shows us the Karma that imparts to us the intent of that greatness which teaches the sense of Dharma to discover it, that is the Guru. There is no point in making any other justifications. Therefore, this must become a matter of your interest. It does not have to happen immediately. But it can happen. You should not think that each of you was born yesterday and grew up today. Consider that you are as old as the vastness of this world. Only when you see your life across such a distance can you discover the evolutionary course of that life. Any greatness that takes the Dharma residing in the course of Karma, which exists both subtly and grossly, and imparts it to you—that is the accessible Guru. Having learned thus, may you gain the familiarity to respect and absorb it. This is what I have to say.
Guruvani

We were talking about the Swami who came from Bihar. He would feel like he was seeing gods and goddesses. He has been seeing this for a long time. Just three days after coming here, it started becoming clear. Once it became clear, he started seeing words and the places he had visited. This is for you to understand. Why did it become clear when he came here? You should understand that too. Many among those standing here have seen this. But there is a plight where you cannot understand it, which the Vaishya and Shudra have. What is that? They were turned into a group dedicated only to agriculture and trade. Later, those who made tools on this earth were set aside into the category of carpenters, brass-smiths, blacksmiths, and goldsmiths. They were also given separate gods. We have been defeated in this divine system that has evolved over a long time. It is when we look at what happened to us because of this that we understand the extent of the blunder we made. But how can we understand that? We certainly cannot. An example of this is the Trinity system mentioned to you, that is, Shaktheyam, Shaivam, Vaishnavam, or Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva—whatever you call itٹ In this, isn't Shaktheyam included? So, even if we study these four Vedas and six Shastras, we do not understand its nature at all. We also do not know why we cannot understand it. After that, many visionaries, saints, or apostles came like this, and we now hear the story of two people who came as visionaries like the many Thangals. But there is no way to say they are visionaries. Why? When looking at their history, what we see in the history that goes beyond two thousand years is different. They brought it as the Old Testament or New Testament, and Islam evolved from that. There is some truth in that Islam. But even though this truth arrived, our own people, unable to accept or respect it, converted and became Muslims, Jains, Buddhists, and Christians. After this happened, what should they do? When they changed over, they separated from us again and started fighting. They stand apart and fight over whose god is greater. Nothing else is needed. Now, Rama's story is a matter that happened about seventeen lakh years ago. You might think it happened yesterday or the day before. No. If the story of Rama is this long, where will we go in the timeline of its ancestors and the religion and religious philosophy that operated within its thought process? We don't know this either. So, a culture of India that raised us in a way where we do not know such a side has drifted away in a completely inadequate manner. It has gone far away from us.

Our girls should not listen to the Vedas. Or they should not study the Vedas. Or they are not allowed to handle them in a good manner . It is from this mother that we get children. We raise them as little ones, and when they grow up a bit, we get them married off. What do we get from this? If needed, they turn around, go there, and along with their children and their family, there will be fights, quarrels, and disputes with the brother in this house . They say this has been happening since the time of Sree Krishna. In truth, it is not like that . It has existed for so much time before that. We don't even know this . There is a reason for it to exist since the time of Sree Krishna. Because Tretayuga and Dwapara are not capable of anyone doing anything , it is a time that is meant only for those Acharyas (teachers) . After that, when coming again to the side of Kali, it is the Dharma of Kali. If there are any mistakes in the past Tretayuga , Dwapara, and Satyayuga , completely and utterly resolving them and showing the way to go to Satyayuga from now on is the story called Yugadharma. None of us know this . Among us, we have perceived it as just a sight or an offering. Or we have a course of action imagining that if a god or goddess comes, everything is settled . It cannot be anything other than that . You are people who came believing like that. I am also someone who came like that . A complete ignorance has happened to us in this. What is that? A plight where there is no one to explain what Yugadharma is . Caught in that ignorance , all of us--these four groups have gone astray. Suppose our children learn one of the languages as much as possible now. In our native language, they wouldn't even call their father and mother by name . What to do? Is this father and mother, or Appan and Amma--is this good--or is calling them informally and disrespectfully good? They won't speak . To father Da ٹ dy, Da ٹ .d y--see! So this not only makes our children not call out in our language , but also , this child can only develop a completely strange curiosity. After imparting this tendency , if they get a degree or go for a job through some education, it has become a trend where it is enough to come and see the father and mother for one or two days a year . Then after that, if the job is outside, rarely they and their kids would come taking turns, and in about ten years it will fade away and end. Then they wouldn't have the need to come here . Or if they come, they will adopt the ways over there--to drop them somewhere and go. Like that, many people have come here and asked me. That's why I am saying, children please listen, when they grow old, you should take them somewhere and dump them, okay. Did you hear what was said? They have found a language for that. Shall I say that? Vayojana Kendram (Old age home) ! Just take them there and leave them. So in this way we became bad; pushing our children into that is the language the father and mother teach--Daddy, Mummy. So if this complete theory is what you are bringing about, you are unfit to be called father and mother, or neighbors . What is it? Such a good language . Like in India , giving such a high position to father and mother, such a destiny of karma hasn't happened anywhere else.

Today, there is a great conflict among siblings and among others! The reason for all this is that when we were neither taught, nor did we study, nor did we understand what the aforementioned system of the Chaturyuga entails, we became ready today to imitate whatever foreign countries exhibit, to the extent that it has no connection to our own lives. By making our children adopt all these guises exhibited by foreign countries, the child grows up devoid of any affinity for their native land, leading to the greatest ruin through education; and then, once they reach college, there is another "good thing". What is it? I do not even know how to express it in their language. I will say what I have heard from you—ragging. What, isn't it good? So, this is what we educate and send our little ones for. After studying like this, what will these children do? Where will they end up? With whom do they have a connection? With whom will you connect them? Whenever you try to hand over any kind of administrative discipline to them, they will turn into governing machines looking up to some other country. It is a process of learning by looking somewhere else, in such a way that we cannot derive any action from them that is rooted in the inherent nature of this country. Today, even computers have arrived. In this scientific system, what is the point in taking another's language, attire, knowledge, and commerce into our hands and then claiming that we are not accepting them? Therefore, this does not mean that what was invented somewhere in this country is either unwanted or wanted. India had methods that discovered things far beyond all these. What is that? We have heard it before. The guru of Bharadwaja, who invented what is called the Pushpaka Vimana during the time of Sri Rama, said, "This is not needed." Why? Saying that it is not suitable for the present times. But what you have heard about this is completely an alien version. Why? When the guru told this to Bharadwaja, he felt, "He is saying this so that I do not get it executed." That is why he went to the land of Kubera, explained it to the king there, had it built, and returned here. We must see whether the guru's initial warning that it would cause destruction came true. Coming here, he abducted the wife of the king here. Isn't that the nature of conflict? Have you ever thought like that until now? But then, because they did not deviate from the truth, even though she was taken away, she was not destroyed. She was recovered. No matter what we get, it is of no use to us. Our people went and discovered it. Such an aircraft was transformed into so many types, and today there are numerous varieties of it. So, if we shoot it with a machine gun, the glass will not break if hit. That is its strength. So, we have not yet started inventing anything like that. We assume that everything has already been accomplished here, or that we previously had none of these in our hands. That is not correct. We had all these in our hands. Because our ignorance manifested inherently in this manner, someone from here took it outside in a way that could destroy our country, and it went into the world, falling into the hands of the British or the Germans, and changed in many ways. Today, America has become its owner and is making us tremble. You must understand this. You are sending your children along this path to wherever the mother is seated and the father is seated. Where is the father seated? In Russia, isn't it? Isn't the "Comrade" coming as the father? Isn't he the one cooperating with us? Then, would it suffice to call him anything other than "Comrade"? Are not the mother and father cooperating with us? So, how ugly is the misfortune of India, which is prepared to call and teach the little ones in this state! Therefore, apart from the fact that we have been suppressed and confined within a specific religious framework where everything is bound up in the Trimurti system, having brought upon ourselves such karma, introducing our children in a way that is useless to this land and country, turning them into progeny devoid of rightful duty, and causing confusion in the order of worship, what have we gained? These might be the words you are hearing for the first time. But as long as you do not understand that this is applicable to you, to me, and to wherever the world exists hereafter, to whom will you say this? How will you explain this to your children? After understanding it in this manner, I had to take my time. I was also someone who firmly believed in your logic. What is it? In the Trimurti system. The proposition of our epics and Puranas is that if all the gods appear, or even if just one god appears, it is sufficient. But there are many among us who have seen various deities. However, they have not gained anything so far.

Haven't you seen a lot? And what came of it? You might think this is a lie. If you look in here, you can find around twenty-five such instances. Among those who have come here, there must be at least ten. Try asking them. But just because we have seen all this, it means nothing to us. That is why it was narrated like a story of the Bihar Swami. After he came here, on the third day, it became clear, and then it started showing in various ways. Finally, unable to stand it, there was great distress. Then I had told him, you will feel distressed when you see this. But the fact is that this is wrong. This will become clear. If it becomes clear, you do what is necessary. But once it became clear, unable to stand or sit, he was constantly filled with joy and kept jumping around. Unable to stand still on the ground, he was shivering with the joy of seeing all this. After a while, he would start crying in the same manner. He would start laughing in the same manner. He displayed many such things here. He is here. So, what have they convinced us by saying all this? That through the manifestation of a single deity, everything will be accomplished for us. Haven't we come to the point where we can see that whatever you have worshiped in that manner, all of it comes and even bows down to the Guru? Even then, it went wrong. What we need to understand is that we cannot say there is no flawed karma that occurred to us in some era. There is. How to change what is there, how we should lead our lives after changing it, what all will come in that life, what hardships and losses will occur. We should never take our own intellect and use it in that. Such an intellect should not arise. I will not allow you to bring in anything excessively under the assumption that everything will come to you now. That is how I am being careful. I have not convinced you of anything by talking and made you do it. Have I? I will not do it. For us, it is purely a time destined by God. That is what you must understand. What is it? His task is for the Vaishya and the Shudra to rise, and by pulling along the Brahmana and the Kshatriya, take them to where they need to reach. Our philosophical perspective is a dharma derived as a custom for this duty.
Guruvani
